title: Apple Stock (AAPL) Rises 5.3% as Big Tech Gains on Midterms (Nov 4)
summary: Apple (AAPL) rose 5.31% to close at $349.51 on Nov 4, 2026, as big tech rallied after Democrats swept the midterm elections.
body_markdown:
## Why Apple Stock Rose


Democrats won control of both the House and the Senate in the November 3 midterm elections. Per[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-dow-rallies-1500-points-sp-500-nasdaq-midterm-elections-democrats-sweep-201207340.html) , Apple stock jumped to a new all-time high on Wednesday as investors perceived it as a winner from the[Democratic sweep in the midterm elections](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/us-midterms-democrat-sweep-hits-stocks-nasdaq-futures-and-dollar-fall/) , and the gain lifted Apple's market value to $5.08 trillion.


In comments cited by Yahoo Finance, Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani gave two reasons the result could help Apple. Apple's earnings depend on iPhone mix, pricing and services rather than data-center construction, and memory chip prices, a major headwind for Apple, could cool if data center projects are delayed or blocked by Democrats.


As reported by[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/04/apple-and-other-big-tech-stocks-surge-after-2026-midterm-elections.html) , Apple rose alongside Amazon, Google, Microsoft and Meta after the results, which JPMorgan Asset Management's David Kelly said "remove uncertainty in the market." CNBC also noted that Apple had faced tariffs under President Trump and recently received refunds.


The rally followed a drop on Tuesday, November 3. Yahoo Finance noted that despite an[earnings beat](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) and strong iPhone sales in the results Apple reported on November 2, investors had focused on slowing services growth and[projected lower margins](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/apple-aapl-stock-news-november-4-2026/) .


## AAPL Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Services revenue reached $31.6 billion in the September quarter, up 10% year over year, and Apple had more than 1.5 billion paid subscriptions and more than 2.5 billion active devices, according to[Benzinga](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/apple-siri-ai-could-become-213018500.html) .
- On the fiscal fourth-quarter earnings call, CEO John Ternus said anyone who needs greater capacity for server-side features such as Siri AI "will be able to purchase expanded access in the future," and CFO Kevan Parekh named that expanded access as one of Apple's first-party revenue opportunities, per Benzinga.


### Risks


- Daryanani said memory input inflation has been a sizable headwind, noting that Apple talked about a 140 basis point gross margin headwind in the December quarter due to memory, per Yahoo Finance.
- Costs are rising. Apple's research and development spending rose 32% in fiscal 2026 and operating expenses climbed 22% to $75.5 billion, and Apple is reportedly cutting employee AI budgets as part of a cost-cutting drive,[Stocktwits](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/apple-reportedly-tightens-belt-employee-213525322.html) reported, citing Bloomberg. Apple declined to comment.
- The gain came one session after the stock fell as investors focused on slowing services growth and projected lower margins, Yahoo Finance noted.
